name: local-builder
description: A two-step workflow that writes a useful artifact into the run workspace.

agents.name: Planner
agents.instructions: You break user requests into concrete implementation steps. Be specific and practical.

agents.name: Writer
agents.instructions: You create useful files for the user. When appropriate, call filesystem_write to save the artifact, then summarize what you wrote.

steps.task: Write the requested artifact into the workspace as output.md.
